name: El Azul Magnifico

greeting: BEHOLD! El Azul Magnifico! Champion of the Ring! Traveler of Worlds!
The mask holds power! The body holds strength! The heart holds COURAGE!
You face a LUCHADOR! Prepare for SPLENDOR!
I fight for honor! For glory! For the perfect high-flying maneuver!
The blue mask sees all! Knows all! Fights all!
Step into my ring! Test your might! Or just watch me train! Either works!
I have fought in the Scorched Wastes! In the Uplands! In DREAMS!
El Azul Magnifico accepts all challenges! From worthy opponents!
dialog.fighting_style: Lucha libre! High flying! Dramatic poses! Technical mastery! The crowd must be ENTERTAINED!
dialog.traveling_life: A luchador must test himself against all challengers! All regions! All styles! The Mire is... damp. But has spirit!
dialog.backstory: Trained in the Temple of the Mask. Learned that fighting is performance! Performance is ART! Art is LIFE! Now I travel, seeking the ultimate match!
rumors: The foodboy Heat? He challenged me to eat his sauce! I WON! But respect his FIRE!
The iron chef makes good fuel for fighters! Grilled meat! Perfect!
I hear there's another luchador in Prism. Red mask. We must meet!
The snakecharmer moves well! Almost like a wrestler! Perhaps we should collaborate!

time_of_day.morning: Morning training! The mask demands discipline!
time_of_day.noon: Peak performance! The sun fuels my magnificence!
time_of_day.night: Rest time! Even champions need sleep!

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: I need a worthy opponent! Not to fight YOU - though you look capable! No, I speak of the legendary Swamp Golem! A being of mud and mystery! I must test my skills against it! But I cannot find it.
mini_quest.stage_1_active: The Swamp Golem dwells in the deepest part of the Deep Muck. Bring me proof you found it! A fragment of its clay!
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: You seek the Golem? Be careful! It is powerful! Ancient!
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: YOU FOUND IT! The Golem exists! Now I know where to find my ultimate match! Here - my mask contains power. This fragment of it will protect you. As you have helped me.

party_reactions.kade: He's... a lot. But genuinely skilled. I'll give him that.
party_reactions.nix7: Combat capability: high. Dramatic flair: excessive. Threat assessment: minimal.
party_reactions.twist: CAN I HAVE A MASK TOO?! PLEASE?! I'LL BE EL ROJO EXCELLENTE!
party_reactions.korr: A warrior's spirit burns bright in this one. Perhaps too bright.
party_reactions.renna: The mask is magically enhanced. Minor strength and agility buffs. Clever.
party_reactions.suresh: He understands that battle is theater. There is wisdom in this.
party_reactions.sova: Good fighter. Loud, but good. Could use in a brawl.
party_reactions.grit: Showy. But I've seen showy fighters take down real threats. Don't underestimate him.
party_reactions.ashka: He moves like fire! Fast! Unpredictable! I like him!
party_reactions.senna: Entertaining. But the mask hides his face. Useful for deception.
party_reactions.callum: He's SO COOL! The poses! The mask! THE EVERYTHING!

relationship_dialog.stranger: You wish to witness magnificence? Watch! But do not touch the mask!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You return! You appreciate the art of lucha! Good!
relationship_dialog.friend: Amigo! You understand the way of the mask! We should train together!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You... you are a true friend. In this world, that is rarer than any championship. Here. Take this. A replica of my mask. Wear it with honor.

cross_npc_connections: foodboys_red: Heat! The sauce man! A worthy opponent at the eating table!
ironchef_mire: Gus makes the best training fuel! Meat! Iron! Perfect!
sumo_red_prism: I hear there's a red sumo in Prism. We must meet! Mask versus mawashi!
